name: Pashhur
overview: Pashhur is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Malchijah. His tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not recorded in the biblical text. The primary biblical reference to him is found in Jeremiah 38:1.
namesAndTitles: The name Pashhur is a proper name that may mean 'be quiet and round about.' This meaning is not explicitly given by God but is a possible interpretation of the Hebrew name as found in Jeremiah 38:1.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Pashhur is the son of Malchijah, as explicitly stated in Jeremiah 38:1. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Pashhur's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his identification as the son of Malchijah in Jeremiah 38:1. While further details about his role or actions are not provided, his mention situates him within the context of the events described in the book of Jeremiah.
